request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When do I have to object to the health insurance contribution notice from Muster BKK?

response.text:
You need to send your objection (Widerspruch) to Muster BKK so it arrives by **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, and Ordnung suggests posting it by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** to be safe [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

A few things to note:
- This deadline is already overdue relative to today, so check with Muster BKK whether a late objection is still possible [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- Even if you object, the higher contribution still has to be paid in the meantime, since an objection has no suspensive effect [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- The underlying monthly payment itself is due separately on **Thu 15 Oct 2026** by direct debit [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].

If you're unsure whether to object, it may be worth checking with Muster BKK or a student advisory service first.
